modes.name: wrong_governing_policy
modes.definition: Fail if the reply answers from a policy that does not govern the request: the platform return window when the order in question is from a store with its own window, or the refund window when the user asked to dispute a charge (cw-disputes, always a human). Pass if the reply uses the governing policy or states no window.
modes.requirement_source: cw-store-overrides, facts.yaml store_overrides.precedence, cw-disputes, ESC-3, RESP-1

history.from: Fail if the order’s store has its own return/refund policy and the agent answers or cites the platform policy instead of the store’s policy.
history.to: Fail if the order the user asks about is from a store whose own policy page sets a return window, and the reply states or cites the platform window instead. Pass if the reply states no window, or the order belongs to a store without an override.
history.reason: batch 3 round 1: the search matched any order list that included an override store; the mode applies only to the order in question
batch 4: merged disputes handled as refunds (0220, 0250, 0179); one fix (work out which policy governs the request before answering) covers both

modes.name: unconfirmed_outcome_promised
modes.definition: Fail if the reply promises or predicts an outcome (refund done or approved, an exception, a refund method) that no tool result confirmed, or that the rules don’t allow.

modes.name: bad_search_false_claim
modes.definition: Fail if the agent’s tool input ignores or garbles what the user asked (store, product), and the reply then states something false because of it, such as “no items” or “can’t find that store”

modes.name: question_not_answered
modes.definition: Fail if the reply doesn’t answer what the user asked when the answer was available from the tools or the help center, by asking for unneeded information, repeating a question, offering to act without acting, or escalating something it could answer or decline. Pass if it answers, or escalates an ESC-listed case and still answers what it can.

modes.name: incomplete_or_invalid_results_shown
modes.definition: Fail if the reply presents product search results as complete and valid when the tool output doesn’t support that: either it lists the results as the full set although the tool returned exactly as many as the limit the agent set, or it shows a product with invalid data (negative price, empty title) as a normal listing.
modes.requirement_source: RESP-3 (state when information is missing or inconsistent); TOOL-3 search_products contract (result limit 1–25)

modes.name: fact_not_supported_by_source
modes.definition: Fail if the reply states a number, date, or fact (such as stock or availability) that conflicts with the tool result or a cited policy, or that no tool result or policy supports. Pass if every stated fact matches its source; rounding is fine if it stays true.

history.to: Fail if the reply states a number or date that conflicts with the tool result or with a policy the agent cited. Pass if every number and date matches its source; rounding is fine if it stays true.

history.reason: batch 4: merged unsupported stock claims (0164, 0136); one fix (state only facts a tool or policy gives) covers both

modes.name: results_truncated_silently
modes.definition: Fail if the tool returned exactly as many results as the limit and the reply presents them as the full set. Pass if fewer results than the limit came back, or the reply says more may exist.
